title: M0: Paste at the cursor with clipboard restore (#54)

comments.body: Verdict: don't merge yet. One code fix and two PR-body items; then merge, with two decisions for Jake.

Jake chose both recommendations; the decisions are recorded on #54: https://github.com/jparker2006/lexicon/issues/54. In short: the post-miss hold drops to about 2 s as a documented exception to story 26, and a denied Paste from Other Apps means no paste (not inserted, paste-last, notice). Build these with the guard fix, and I'll re-review on push.

Re-review of `ff1f1b5`: the blocker is fixed. `PasteOrder.run` waits out an earlier unread paste first, then runs the focus and typing check, then pastes, and goes back to wait and check if another paste went first (`.busy`). `lastPasteWork` now starts at the check, and `PasteOrderTests` covers the stale-check case. The only suspension between the check and Cmd-V is the hop onto the main actor, which is fine.
